title: FACET Run-vs-Run Per-Mode Comparison Report v0
description: Machine-readable Stage-18 run-vs-run per-mode comparison schema v0 for segfacet.eval.report (item 101). Bundles two runs' provenance/run-manifest identity plus the full RunComparison.to_dict() diff.

schema_version.description: Version discriminator for this comparison-report schema. Always '0.1' for v0.

run_a.description: Run A's identity: provenance plus optional run-manifest.

run_b.description: Run B's identity: provenance plus optional run-manifest.

comparison.description: The RunComparison.to_dict() bundle (item 101): eight per-Section-6-failure-mode deltas plus the aggregate Dice deltas and the attributed mode. Nested shapes (per_mode entries) are already guaranteed by RunComparison.to_dict() and are not enumerated leaf-by-leaf here.

runSide.description: One side's report identity: the EvaluationProvenance block plus an optional run_manifest block, embedded verbatim from that run's own eval_report.json.

excluded_modes.description: Item 109 (AC8b): failure_mode ints, ascending, that carry a real delta but no normalised_delta -- excluded from magnitude-ranked attribution rather than silently dropped. Possibly empty.

unattributable_reason.description: Item 109 (AC8b/AC9): null whenever attributed_mode is not null; otherwise a non-empty human-readable string naming why no mode is attributable.
